note: Where product feedback goes. A mailto address, nothing more: the page itself never sends anything, so the on-device claim and invariant 11 are untouched. Set `address` to a forwarding alias rather than a personal inbox — this sits on a public page, it will be scraped, and it will receive distress mail alongside product notes. While `address` is null the whole section is hidden, so an unset value ships safely rather than shipping a broken link.
subject: Reitti preview — a note
because: The preview exists to be argued with, and the people best placed to argue with it are clinicians and county staff who have no other way to reach us. A link that costs nothing to ship is worth more than a feedback form that would put a server between a person and their own answers.
